linkStrategy: VtmlUtil itemstack accepts codes only, not JsonItemStack attributes. Use single-quoted VTML href with raw JSON double quotes; escape the outer language/config JSON with a JSON serializer. Do NOT HTML-encode JSON quotes as ": VtmlParser does not decode entities in attribute values. Use representative.richtextLink as real navigation; unattributed itemstack icons are decorative and may navigate to a missing bare page.
